1308-2034-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

687-5004-6495--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-5004-6495--73.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
687-5004-6495--73.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

304-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
304-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
304-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tough Cookie.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-4050-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-6752.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2728-4153-5147-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-4153-5147-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-4153-5147-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

1115-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Hammer of Purphoros can be omitted.

147-643-7884.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sygg's Command
147-643-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sygg's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Sygg's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-643-7884.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

969-2034-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

5220-6505-6900-7452.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1849-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

423-1257-1437-3147--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-3147--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-7297.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-7297.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
5686-6972-7237.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7229.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7160.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

225-539-872-907.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

573-5451-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5451-5702-6664.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1365-1651-4779-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-4779-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2308-5931.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-5931.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1029-1902-5028.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1029-1902-5028.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Wirewood Channeler.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1902-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

252-4659-5394.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

618-859-2999-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-2999-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

1046-1479-2692.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-2692.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
When the Cat Beast enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1799-2048-3621-5231.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
1799-2048-3621-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

14-141-2034.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

959-1257-1644-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Islands.
959-1257-1644-4423.description:
Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Mystic Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, triggering itself and Tatyova.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, returning Tidal Bore from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2744-3129-3693-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2744-3129-3693-3828.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista, you may remove them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

417-2027.description:
Gravity Sphere causes all creatures to lose flying.
Magus of the Moat prevents non-flying creatures from attacking, and since no creatures can have flying, no creatures can attack.
